task.title: Step 02: CODE-DESIGNER fix design for GH-791 / ISS-0706
task.description: Produce a fix design artefact at src/design/iss-0706-gbl116-bench-pre-flight.md that details the actual code change. Read the diagnosis file (handoffs/WF03-GH791-20260815/diagnosis-01.md) and the relevant source files (migrations/GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup.sql, src/tools/migrate.zig, build.zig, tests/bench/bench.zig). The recommended approach is (a) + (d): inject BPM_DB_URL into the bench step's migrate child process + fail loudly inside migrate.zig when provisionTenantSchema leaves migrations_applied_at NULL. Write the design as interfaces/types/data-flow — NOT implementation code. The design must be complete enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement without ambiguity.

context.recommended_approach: (a) + (d) — inject BPM_DB_URL into the bench step's migrate child process + fail loudly inside migrate.zig when provisionTenantSchema leaves migrations_applied_at NULL

design_required_sections: ## Files to change (with line numbers and signature diffs)
## Migration safety (the gate stays strict for production; only the bench path is relaxed/fixed)
## Test plan (regression-test plan; what new tests to add, what existing tests to verify)
## Acceptance criteria (list of MUST-NOT and MUST conditions, each verifiable)
## Dependencies (depends on which other fixes, if any; order of changes)
## MUST-NOT-depend on (anti-dependencies — do not modify X)
